FN-KKIEAA5-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 104
Committee: Veterans and Military Affairs Sponsor: Senator Robert Stewart
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 02/12/2025
Senate Bill 104 as introduced would increase membership on the Alabama Job Creation and
Military Stability Commission by two additional members, which would increase the
obligations of the State General Fund by an estimated $550 per meeting to reimburse the two
additional legislative members for legislative compensation, per diem and travel expenses for
attending meetings of the Commission, when the Legislature is not in session.
